method: Manual whole-file reading of both headers; pinned Git byte comparison. No application/runtime control execution.
findings: CItem type mask separates base/pseudo file kinds, hash-stage bits, reparse-kind bits and general flags including DONE/MTP. DONE tests enumeration state, not complete-content identity or mutation validation.
IsTypeOrFlag combines supplied masks then tests any matching bit, not all. Callers needing conjunction must use separate tests; no assertion all callers correct before full review.

Logical/physical byte sums and file index use64bit values; per-subtree file/folder/read-job counts are atomic ULONG32 on Windows. Whole-tree counts above32bit limits not qualified by64bit byte storage. No billion-node runtime test.

GetItemsRecursive traverses children with explicit stack and invokes predicate only on nodes without children. Default predicate selects IT_FILE. Loaded top-list population therefore collects file leaves rather than every directory; pseudo/hardlink handling depends on their flags.

m_index is a general-purpose field for special scan types, not universal persistent identity: header also supports linked items, MTP and preview flags. Separate source-specific identity checks remain necessary.
SupportsFilesystemApis excludes MTP flag only; shell-identity capability is a separate method. This inline predicate does not by itself establish current path existence or immutable source identity.

Model stores non-owning selected-item vector/span cache keyed by logical focus and validity flag; InvalidateSelectionCache clears validity, notifications invalidate. All mutation invalidation paths still need remaining Actions/Control review.

SExtensionRecord uses separate relaxed atomic count/byte accumulators, not a jointly consistent snapshot or checked arithmetic. A read pair during active updates need not describe one instant; no concurrency stress proof.
limits: Header contracts and storage widths only; no overflow, race, malformed model or Windows runtime execution.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred.
